scenes.narration: At 2:22 in the morning my video call showed one extra participant.
I was on a late call with my team. Four tiles on the screen. Then a fifth, small and dark, with no name. Just a grey silhouette.
I asked, who is that? Nobody answered. My colleagues kept talking, as if the tile was not there.
The silhouette's microphone icon turned green. Speaking. The call stayed silent, but the captions began to appear, one word at a time.
Turn around, said the captions. And then, softer. Not yet. Wait for the others to leave.
One by one my colleagues left the call. Goodnight. See you tomorrow. Until only two tiles remained. Mine, and the dark one.
I looked at my own tile. In the corner of the room behind me, something stood perfectly still. The captions said, there. Now we are alone. And then, the call ended, from my side.
So tell me. Do you look behind you, or close the laptop?
